name: Aventi
sourceDistinctions: Page 34 gives the detailed player profile with Human and Aquatic subtypes. Pages 138–139 supply separate class-based encounter examples.
Water Spell Power applies only to the printed Water descriptor. Create Water qualifies, but the core Water Breathing spell has no Water descriptor.
Amphibious permits air and water breathing without limit. Human Blood applies race-related effects and does not provide standard human bonus feats or skills.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Stormwrack errata file. The official FAQ has no Aventi entry.
